name: screensize
trans: 设置画布大小及颜色

name: setup
trans: n. equipment designed to serve a specific function; the way something is organized or arranged

name: forward
trans: adv. at or to or toward the front; ('forrad' and 'forrard' are dialectal variations); forward in time or order or degree
adj. at or near or directed toward the front
v. send or ship onward from an intermediate post or station in transit

name: backward
trans: adv. at or to or toward the back or rear; in a manner or order or direction the reverse of normal
adj. directed or facing toward the back or rear

name: right
trans: n. an abstract idea of that which is due to a person or governmental body by law or tradition or nature
adj. being or located on or directed toward the side of the body to the east when facing north; free from error; especially conforming to fact or truth
adv. precisely, exactly; immediately

name: left
trans: adj. being or located on or directed toward the side of the body to the west when facing north; not used up
n. location near or direction toward the left side; i.e. the side to the north when a person or object faces east
adv. toward or on the left; also used figuratively

name: circle
trans: n. ellipse in which the two axes are of equal length; a plane curve generated by one point moving at a constant distance from a fixed point
v. travel around something; move in circles

name: dot
trans: n. a very small circular shape
v. scatter or intersperse like dots or studs

name: speed
trans: n. distance travelled per unit time; a rate (usually rapid) at which something happens
v. move fast; move faster

name: pendown
trans: 移动时绘制图形，缺省时也为绘制，简化为down()

name: penup
trans: 移动时不绘制图形，提起笔，用于另起一个地方绘制时用，简化为up()

name: goto
trans: 将画笔移动到坐标为x,y的位置

name: setx
trans: 将当前x轴移动到指定位置

name: sety
trans: 将当前y轴移动到指定位置

name: setheading
trans: 设置当前朝向为angle角度，简化为seth(angle)

name: home
trans: n. where you live at a particular time; housing that someone is living in
adv. at or to or in the direction of one's home or family; on or to the point aimed at
adj. used of your own ground; relating to or being where one lives or where one's roots are

name: pensize
trans: 绘制图形时的画笔宽度

name: pencolor
trans: 画笔颜色

name: shape
trans: n. any spatial attributes (especially as defined by outline); the spatial arrangement of something as distinct from its substance
v. shape or influence; give direction to; make something, usually for a specific function

name: fillcolor
trans: 图形的填充颜色

name: color
trans: n. a visual attribute of things that results from the light they emit or transmit or reflect; interest and variety and intensity
v. add color to; affect as in thought or feeling
adj. having or capable of producing colors

name: begin_fill
trans: 准备开始填充图形

name: end_fill
trans: 填充完成

name: hideturtle
trans: 隐藏箭头显示，简化为ht()

name: showturtle
trans: 与hideturtle()函数对应，简化为st()

name: clear
trans: adj. readily apparent to the mind; free from confusion or doubt
v. rid of obstructions; make a way or path by removing objects
adv. completely

name: reset
trans: v. set anew
